comments.comment: The new cache step uses actions/cache@v4, a tag, though AGENTS.md says to pin every GitHub Action to a full commit SHA with its version in a comment.
comments.failureScenario: The step uses actions/cache@v4, a tag its owner can move. AGENTS.md says "Pin every GitHub Action to a full commit SHA, with its version in a comment", and the two steps above follow it; if v4 is retagged, the workflow runs code nobody reviewed.
